# Ruben Marcus: AI Fullstack Engineer

> AGENT-READY · HUMANS WELCOME
>
> Personal site of Ruben Marcus, an AI fullstack engineer based in Lisbon
> (remote worldwide). 14+ years across AI tooling, web products, Web3, fintech, and e-commerce.
> Builds autonomous AI agent systems, evaluation harnesses, AEO tooling, and
> premium web experiences. Available for full-time roles and freelance contracts.

## Main sections

- [Index](https://www.rubenmarcus.dev/): Hero, services (hire me for), proof-in-numbers stats, open-source tools, selected work.
- [Portfolio](https://www.rubenmarcus.dev/portfolio): Filterable 14-year project archive. Filter by era/company and technology.
- [AI](https://www.rubenmarcus.dev/ai): AI expertise (agent orchestration, evaluation design, AEO, production LLM features) and the open-source tools that prove it.
- [Agent Skills](https://www.rubenmarcus.dev/skills): Versioned operating methods created for verifiable frontend, writing, debugging, games, and agent systems.
- [Agents](https://www.rubenmarcus.dev/agents): The autonomous agent fleet behind this site and client work — roles, orchestration model, and what each agent ships.
- [MCP / Connect](https://www.rubenmarcus.dev/connect): Connect this portfolio to an AI client so an agent can inspect evidence, check availability, and book an intro.
- [Blog](https://www.rubenmarcus.dev/blog): Technical articles on agents, benchmarks, WebGL, and the stack.
- [About](https://www.rubenmarcus.dev/about): Bio, timeline, contact details.
- [Contact](https://www.rubenmarcus.dev/contact): Project inquiries for AI products, agent systems, AI-native frontend, and AEO.

## Services

- [AI products & agent systems](https://www.rubenmarcus.dev/services/ai-product-systems): Architecture, working product slices, model routing, evals, observability, and cost controls.
- [AI-native frontend & design engineering](https://www.rubenmarcus.dev/services/ai-native-frontend): Responsive production interfaces, interactive experiences, performance, and visual regression.
- [AEO audit & implementation](https://www.rubenmarcus.dev/services/aeo): Technical SEO/AEO, entities, canonical discovery, structured data, content, and citation surfaces.

## Products and tools

- [Ralph Starter](https://ralphstarter.ai): AI coding orchestration platform. Multi-agent swarms over isolated git worktrees, MCP server.
- [Autoresearcher](https://autoresearcher.org): Benchmark-driven autonomous research CLI. Multi-agent co-evolution with a Pareto frontier.
- [AEO.js](https://aeojs.org): Answer Engine Optimization framework. AI-crawler policy analysis, llms.txt and ai-index.json exports.
- [check.aeojs.org](https://check.aeojs.org): Free AEO scanner. 4,569 scans across 2,259 unique sites.
- [ScanRepo](https://scanrepo.dev): Repository intelligence product.
- [CS Brasil](https://csbrasil.online): Browser FPS and AI-native product engineering testbed.

## Selected technical case studies

- [Ralph Starter](https://www.rubenmarcus.dev/work/ralph-starter): Multi-agent delivery harness using isolated worktrees, race, consensus, and pipeline modes.
- [AEO.js + AEO Checker](https://www.rubenmarcus.dev/work/aeo-platform): Diagnosis and implementation treated as one verifiable AEO system.
- [CS Brasil](https://www.rubenmarcus.dev/work/cs-brasil): Three.js browser FPS built with repository skills, visual QA, regression gates, and product telemetry.

## Proof points

- CS Brasil (browser FPS): 2,191 players, 154K+ kills, 27 countries.
